verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product AI assistant is a single line on the pricing page listing a "Cloud Development Agent" for Medusa Cloud, with no description of what tasks it handles or how users delegate to it. The other AI items cover external agents: the docs MCP server for IDE tools like Cursor, and framework "guardrails for agents". Neither is a built-in assistant, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the Cloud Development Agent's capabilities and delegation workflow, evidence of an assistant inside the admin dashboard, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
